verdict.rationale: Orama Cloud officially supports SDKs for JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, and Rust, and the open-source library installs through JavaScript package managers (npm, yarn, pnpm, bun). That covers only two of the five languages the story names. Missing for 10: official PHP, Ruby, and Go SDKs; evidence that the SDKs are kept current; framework-specific integrations; independent corroboration of SDK quality.
